description: 8月27日，Hugging Face联合旗下机器人团队Pollen Robotics，正式发布了一款名叫Microduck的开源机器人。这是一只可以用强化学习教会新技能的开源小机器人，它的样子像一只鸭子，会走路，会用喙叼东西，摔倒了还能自己爬起来，甚至可以玩轮滑。 除此之外，本期《FUND财经早班车》还有关于Minimax、智谱、“AI教母”李飞飞的相关新闻，欢迎各位收听！
classificationReason: Covers an open-source robot trained with reinforcement learning, including walking, object carrying, recovery, and skating.
qualityReason: Focused news summary with concrete robot capabilities, but brief and mixed with unrelated AI business news.
